$comment: Maps a release version to the work it carries, so a reader can tell which
build contains which journey. The published artifact is the GitHub tag
archive consumed by Jongtae/homebrew-agentos Formula/agentos.rb; the
formula is not in this repository by an explicit earlier migration

published.carries: Pre-EPIC-PA1. Contains no PA1 child: no Gmail connector, no `agentos service`, no PA1 connector contract, no memory service.
published.observed: Tapped and installed locally at the time of writing (`brew list --versions agentos` -> `agentos 1.0.4`). Local operating observation, not a clean-machine install.

published.carries: EPIC-PA1 #386 children: #387 connector seam, #388 install/background lifecycle, #389 Gmail read/search, #390 Calendar policy core, #391 public research, #392 memory candidates, #382 web management, #393 Telegram capability handoff, #394 integration. Also #476 failed/partial-turn honesty, #488 refused/deferred durable writes, #487 README rewrite, #495 AGPL-3.0-only licence and trademark notice.

journeys.J3: covered offline - live Google OAuth owner_validation_pending
journeys.J5: partial - the routing-site provenance refusal ships; the discrimination itself does NOT. research.PublicResearch is imported by nothing in src/, so it is unreachable from any production path in this build

published.not_claimed: No live Google, OpenRouter or Telegram operation has been observed for any journey.
published.observed: Tap PR Jongtae/homebrew-agentos#17. On the owner's Mac: `brew upgrade` 1.0.4 -> 1.1.0, `brew test` passed, `scripts/quickstart_install_check.py --executable <Cellar>/1.1.0/bin/agentos` reported installed_foreground_smoke with every field true and background_service owner_validation_pending. Local operating observation, not a clean-machine install.
published.archive_sha256_note: The original publication checksum is retained above. Checked on 2026-10-07 after the repository rename, GitHub serves the same v1.1.0 tag URL with the checksum in currently_served_archive_sha256; the former tap formula used that served checksum. The change in archive bytes is not a source-change claim.

published.carries: Current main source since v1.1.0 through febaa5b1: owner-context and Work continuity, model switching, browser/sign-in handoff, skill routing, Presence conversation behavior, and four-language public README/ontology work (#1120, #1123). Source PR #1121 aligned the formula template and traceability checks with the existing pinned mcp-host extra. Tap PR Jongtae/homebrew-agentos#20 installs this tag with that extra and validates its import. Source coverage and deterministic checks do not prove live external integrations.
published.observed: On the owner Mac, Homebrew upgraded agentos 1.1.0 -> 1.1.1 from tap PR Jongtae/homebrew-agentos#20. The served tag archive SHA-256 matched the formula. brew test passed CLI help and mcp.server.stdio import; explicit /opt/homebrew/Cellar/agentos/1.1.1/bin/agentos foreground quickstart smoke reported installed_cli, foreground_start, loopback_host, http_setup, authenticated_note, restart_persistence and single_instance true, with background_service owner_validation_pending. Local installed observation, not a clean-machine install or owner-live provider operation.
published.not_claimed: No live Telegram, Google OAuth, shopping, financial service, or end-to-end README meeting journey was observed for this release. Background service persistence after a machine reboot remains owner validation.

unpublished.why_no_commit: The future tagged main merge commit does not exist; no earlier source SHA can stand in for it.
unpublished.why_no_checksum: No v1.3.0 GitHub tag archive exists; its served SHA-256 must be measured only after publication.
unpublished.carries: Main source since v1.1.1 (v1.2.0 was prepared but never tagged and is folded in): the checksum-pinned one-line uv installer with Homebrew kept and Windows through WSL2 (#1167); own Google client for Drive, Gmail and Calendar with token renewal (#1172) and Works using the owner's AI-side connections read-only by opt-in (#1197); authenticated API reads by secret-slot reference (#1216); conversation-first exact forget, complete deletion and undo of owner Memory, current-state claims and observations (#794 phase 3); host failure instead of worker shortfall when the AgentOS bridge cannot start (#1130); re-delegation evidence for CLI tool calls (#808) and for quiet browser input steps (#899); reply source lists without unused search results (#1009); family-setup tunnel cleanup on restart (#929); browser mobile pages and payment-approval fixes (#1181, #1183); nightly real-WebKit and install-smoke CI. Tests and CI do not prove live external integrations.
